def: to emaciate, i.e. make (become) thin (literally or figuratively)

words.word: unto them for he will famish

occurrences.text: The Lord will be terrible unto them: for he will famish all the gods of the earth; and men shall worship him, every one from his place, even all the isles of the heathen.
